title: Cumulative layer offset
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit from $	ext{Fin}\,n$ to a singleton, using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates. For each natural number $m$, define its offset to be the sum of the successor-layer sizes over all layers indexed by $j<m$.
hypotheses_covered: F is a layered circuit from Fin n to a singleton over Boolean values
Every layer's node type is finite
F uses only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates
